name: work-to-skills
description: Finds the areas of your work where you keep giving Claude the same corrections and running the same multi-step flow, and proposes the skills to build for them, with the rules quoted from what you said and a prompt that builds them. Reads your local Claude Code history, /insights analysis and the skills, CLAUDE.md and memory you already have, and points out rules missing from existing skills. Also lists small command/hook automations and tracks whether repeats go down. Local HTML report in Korean or English. 어느 업무 영역에 스킬을 만들지 알려 주는 한국어·영어 리포트.
